summary:
Qualified Chartered Accountant with experience in corporate finance, treasury management, debt syndication, financial modeling, audit, taxation, credit analysis and regulatory
compliance. Skilled in end-to-end debt fundraising, lender negotiations, due diligence, covenant monitoring, cash flow forecasting, DCF valuation, three-statement modeling, budgeting,
variance analysis, and ERP-based reporting. Strong background in bank audits, credit risk review, GST and direct tax compliance, internal controls, and financial analysis, with demonstrated
ability to deliver measurable business outcomes in listed company and CA firm environments.

jobs.company: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited (Listed Entity
bullets: Led end-to-end execution of debt fundraising mandates exceeding INR 270 crore, including structuring, lender negotiations, due diligence, and documentation.

Secured over INR 160 crore in funding from leading financial institutions: Yes Bank for INR 70 crore term loan and INR 35 crore BG. Aditya Birla Capital for INR 35 crore term loan and INR 20 crore Working Capital Demand Loan.
Successfully raised INR 110 crore from public sector undertakings and nationalized banks.
Built advanced financial models, including DCF valuation, three-statement models, sensitivity analysis, and cash flow forecasting, to support investment decisions and capital allocation.

Prepared investor pitch decks and collaborated with merchant bankers, foreign institutional investors, and high-net-worth individuals, enhancing transparency and contributing to investor confidence for capital raising initiatives.
Performed budget planning, cost analysis, and profitability assessment across cost centres and MIS reporting.
Performed ratio analysis on historical data to benchmark results against industry standards, and supported finalization of books and budgeting.
Prepared financial data and reports for monitoring by credit rating agencies.
Directed ERP implementation, improving reporting accuracy and reducing turnaround time, while strengthening capital budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and treasury management.

Successfully managed treasury operations by optimizing surplus fund deployment and reducing opportunity costs through strategic investments in risk-free assets, while coordinating with Big 6 global audit firms on strategic growth initiatives.. Key Impact:
Reduced borrowing costs by 50-60 basis points and optimized cash collateral from 35% to 15%.
Eliminated promoter personal guarantees, strengthening corporate financial independence.
Aligned financial covenants with business performance and growth objectives.

Executed statutory central bank audits for high-value nationalized and cooperative bank branches with credit exposure of INR 900-1,200 crore, evaluating asset quality, identifying credit risks, and strengthening regulatory compliance frameworks.

Conducted quarterly concurrent audits for a cooperative bank and statutory audits for various large and small entities with turnovers ranging from 400-700 crore, across manufacturing, trading, and service industries.
Audited government clients in the banking, finance and insurance sectors and executed monthly and year-end stock audits for multiple manufacturing entities.
Conducted internal audits for entities with turnover exceeding INR 500 crore, including trusts and LLPs, and identified control gaps in material consumption amounting to INR 25 lakh.
Prepared and filed 40+ statutory forms, including Income Tax Returns, TDS, SFT returns, Tax Audit and compliance.
Interpreted tax laws to provide advisory on direct taxation matters.
Prepared and filed GST returns, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-6, GSTR-9, GSTR-9C, GSTR-10, and managed annual GST reconciliation.
Handled GST litigation matters up to the Joint Commissioner level, including handling notices, assessments, and representing cases in hearings.
Executed internal GST audits for companies with turnovers exceeding INR 8,000 crore.
Prepared professional tax returns and completed documentation for government subsidies like the PSI Scheme.
Contributed to the firm's thought leadership by developing 20+ presentations for “Karneeti”, providing financial insights and assisting with seminar audits.
